title: Quest Line 01 — The Krampus Conspiracy
premise: The player arrives in Hollyhollow during its annual Winterwake Festival. Wild Pokémon have turned aggressive, Pokémon are disappearing, and strange black-and-red markings appear on trees and rocks. A mysterious group in dark crimson uniforms — Team Krampus — is behind it all. Their motto: "The world has forgotten what fear is."
